description.value: Whiskey Six BBQ is a cozy West Coast smokehouse specializing in locally sourced, organic barbecue using BC and Fraser Valley meats, named after the McLaughlin H44 Buick rum-running car of the 1920s. The restaurant honours Canadian bootlegging history with an extensive selection of brown liquor from Vancouver's own small-batch distilleries alongside rotating East Van craft beers. A touring cyclist stopping in will find a full dine-in smokehouse with takeout available, and a kitchen that welcomes omnivores, vegans, and gluten-intolerant diners alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for the business's identity, address, and offerings. The address on the website (826 Renfrew Street, Vancouver, BC V5K 4B6) clearly places the restaurant in Vancouver, not North Vancouver as listed in the OSM community field — a notable discrepancy. Takeout is explicitly offered ('We will be happy to prepare your Take Out Order'), and dietary accommodation for vegans and gluten-intolerant guests is stated directly ('W6BBQ welcomes everyone with an appetite; omnivores, herbivores, vegans, gluten-intolerant, lactose-intolerant, etc.'). No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities was found.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website address is 826 Renfrew Street, Vancouver, BC V5K 4B6 — this is in the City of Vancouver (East Vancouver), not the District or City of North Vancouver. The OSM record's geographic community attribution appears incorrect.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags; all contact details sourced from website only and cannot be cross-confirmed against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with current 2026 events and a recently verified OSM check_date of 2026-05-07. Takeout available and dietary accommodations confirmed, making it a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'W6BBQ welcomes everyone with an appetite; omnivores, herbivores, vegans, gluten-intolerant, lactose-intolerant, etc. We do our best to accommodate dietary restrictions.' Gluten-free beer also listed on drinks menu
